arguments.reasoning:
Recommendation acceptance (kept separate from candidate selection). Of the diagnostic deferrals, rec-defer-hold-speed-weight-comparison is rejected: its sole premise (no authorized saved-state check or complete experiment) no longer holds, because the improvement phase granted and executed exactly that bounded experiment. rec-defer-causal-replay is retained, so I defer any causal attribution/closed-loop replay claim: a single paired weight change conflates the effect with run-to-run variation and no counterfactual replay exists. Hence disposition=defer on the retained deferral.

Candidate selection (independent of that acceptance). The complete experiment improvement-96f0ade35119 (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0 -> 0.05) is valid and complete (evaluation_validity=valid, valid_complete_execution=true, solver_error_count=0, force_bound_violation_n=0.0) but the sealed comparison classifies it as physical_tradeoff. By dimension: terminal reach worsened 0.007642608585867386 -> 0.00869890424761182 m (delta +0.001056295661744434 m) yet both runs stay inside reach_tolerance_m=0.01 m (candidate terminal_reach_passed=true, F1065); sampled holding position improved 0.05813810428573256 -> 0.05650455971948983 m (delta -0.001633544566242727 m, F799) yet stays above 0.01 m, holding_position_passed=false (F1212); sampled holding speed improved 1.5810152739742807 -> 1.1750052670100422 m/s (delta -0.4060100069642385 m/s, F1563) yet stays ~59x the 0.02 m/s limit, holding_speed_passed=false (F1605); computation worsened, mean complete-update 17.26331904856488 -> 17.77877309145406 s (delta +0.5154540428891785 s, F1139) with deadline_misses unchanged at 35 (F1007). Joint acceptance is unchanged and false in both runs (candidate F1104, baseline F1683). Per the ranking rule (F1646/F1581), a physical improvement accompanied by physical worsening is a trade-off, not overall improvement, so the candidate is not adopted as an improvement; citation of the required candidate-profile fields (F1157, F1185, F1197, F1588) does not establish causality. The baseline configuration af649bf56cf8642bb85090227ec5390398aff23a96686f972933e24715ba8fd0 therefore remains selected. retain_baseline requires baseline, so candidate_disposition=retain_baseline and selected_candidate=baseline. No further execution.
